rows.text: "Our third quarter results surpassed expectations on both revenue and earnings per share, while delivering record annualized recurring revenue of $2.56 billion,” said Rob Painter, President and CEO of Trimble. "Our full year 2026 guidance reflects solid execution against our Connect & Scale strategy, which continues to leverage our unique presence across the physical and digital worlds with our unmatched breadth and depth of connected industry data."
For the full-year 2026, Trimble expects to report revenue between $3,910 million and $3,940 million, GAAP loss per share of $0.55 to $0.49, and non-GAAP earnings per share of $3.63 to $3.69.

For the fourth quarter of 2026, Trimble expects to report revenue between $1,031 million and $1,061 million, GAAP earnings per share of $0.83 to $0.89, and non-GAAP earnings per share of $1.13 to $1.19.
For the full-year 2026, Trimble expects to report revenue between $3,900 million and $3,950 million, GAAP loss per share of $0.07 to $0.12, and non-GAAP earnings per share of $3.60 to $3.70.
For the third quarter of 2026, Trimble expects to report revenue between $953 million and $978 million, GAAP earnings per share of $0.39 to $0.44, and non-GAAP earnings per share of $0.83 to $0.88.
